display_long_description:
# MASTER THE ART OF VR COMBAT
Victory isn't about button mashing. it's about timing, movement, and precision. Trigger attacks using your virtual combat controls while positioning your hero around the arena to outplay your opponent.

[media]

# UNIQUE HEROES. UNIQUE ABILITIES
Every fighter brings a different playstyle. Learn their strengths, master their abilities, and discover the hero that matches your fighting style.

[media]

# SPECIAL ABILITIES CHANGE THE FIGHT
Turn the tide of battle with powerful abilities that reward smart timing and tactical decision-making.

[media]

# TRAIN AGAINST AI
Practice with your favorite heroes, learn their abilities, and improve your skills before entering competitive battles.
